async def act(page):

    group by month and filter to completed orders (if available), run the

          if (!el) continue;
          for (const v of values) {
            try {
              el.value = v;
              el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true}));
              el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));
              return true;
            } catch (e) {
              // ignore and try next value
            }
          }
        }
        return false;
      }

      trySetInput(fromCandidates, fromVals);
      trySetInput(toCandidates, toVals);

      // Try to set grouping to Month and order status to Complete by scanning <select> elements
      const selects = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('select'));
      for (const sel of selects) {

          const monthOpt = opts.find(o => /month/i.test(o.text));

      const monthsFull = ['january','february','march','april','may','june','july','august','september','october','november','december'];
      const monthsShort = ['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'];

      // default mapping 01-12 -> 0
      const map = {};

          const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('th,td'));

          // does first cell look like a month or contain a 2022 marker?
          const hasMonthName = monthsFull.some(m => first.includes(m)) || monthsShort.some(m => first.startsWith(m));

      }

      function parseMonthLabel(label) {
        if (!label) return null;
        const s = label.toLowerCase();
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) if (s.includes(monthsFull[i])) return String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) if (s.startsWith(monthsShort[i])) return String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        // patterns like 2022-03 or 03/2022 or Mar 2022
        const m1 = s.match(/(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})/);
        if (m1 && m1[1] === '2022') return String(Number(m1[2])).padStart(2, '0');
        const m2 = s.match(/(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})/); // 03/2022
        if (m2 && m2[2] === '2022') return String(Number(m2[1])).padStart(2, '0');
        const m3 = s.match(/(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)\b.*2022/);
        if (m3) {
          const idx = monthsShort.indexOf(m3[1]);
          if (idx >= 0) return String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        }
        return null;
      }

      for (const row of foundRows) {
        const mm = parseMonthLabel(row.label);
        if (mm) map[mm] = Number(row.value || 0);
      }

      // produce ordered array of 'MM:COUNT'
      const out = Object.keys(map).sort().map(k => `${k}:${map[k]}`);
      return out;
    }
    ''')
